Start the background workers that fit the Bayesian models

Source: R/page-bayesian.R
cd_start_bayes_workers.Rd

Sets the R session's future plan to multisession, so that the Bayesian page fits its models in other R processes and the app stays usable meanwhile. It changes the plan only while the plan is the default (sequential): a session that already has a plan of its own keeps it, and a second call does nothing. There is one worker by default, so a fit asked for while another runs waits its turn. options(cd2030.bayes_workers = ) sets another number (at least one is always used).

Usage

cd_start_bayes_workers()

Value

The session's future plan, invisibly.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
cd_start_bayes_workers()
future::nbrOfWorkers()

# two fits at a time: set the option before the first call
options(cd2030.bayes_workers = 2)
cd_start_bayes_workers()
} # }
